See also: balenă, baléna, and bałéna

Albanian

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

balena

  1. inflection of balenë:
    1. definite nominative singular
    2. indefinite nominative/accusative plural

Catalan

[edit]
Catalan Wikipedia has an article on:
balena
Wikipedia ca

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin bālaena, from Ancient Greek φάλαινα (phálaina).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central) [bəˈlɛ.nə]
  • IPA(key): (Balearic) [bəˈlə.nə]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [baˈle.na]
  • Audio (Catalonia):(file)

Noun

[edit]

balena f (plural balenes)

  1. whale

Derived terms

[edit]
  • balena amb bec de Cuvier
  • balena amb gep
  • balena blanca
  • balena blava
  • balena grisa
  • balener

Further reading

[edit]
  • “balena”, in Diccionari de la llengua catalana [Dictionary of the Catalan Language] (in Catalan), second edition, Institute of Catalan Studies [Catalan: Institut d'Estudis Catalans], April 2007
  • “balena”, in Gran Diccionari de la Llengua Catalana, Grup Enciclopèdia Catalana, 2026
  • “balena” in Diccionari normatiu valencià, Acadèmia Valenciana de la Llengua.
  • “balena” in Diccionari català-valencià-balear, Antoni Maria Alcover and Francesc de Borja Moll, 1962.

Corsican

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

balena f (plural balene)

  1. whale

References

  • “balena” in INFCOR: Banca di dati di a lingua corsa

Esperanto

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From baleno (“whale”) +‎ -a.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /baˈlena/
  • Rhymes: -ena
  • Syllabification: ba‧le‧na

Adjective

[edit]

balena (accusative singular balenan, plural balenaj, accusative plural balenajn)

  1. cetacean, relating to whales

Anagrams

[edit]
  • abelan

Italian

[edit]

Etymology 1

[edit]

From Late Latin ballēna, from Latin balaena.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /baˈle.na/
  • Rhymes: -ena
  • Hyphenation: ba‧lé‧na

Noun

[edit]

balena f (plural balene)

  1. whale
Descendants
[edit]
  • → Albanian: balenë
  • → Armenian: բաղենա (baġena)
  • → Maltese: balena
  • → Ottoman Turkish: بالنه (balena)
    • Turkish: balina
    • → Azerbaijani: balina
    • → Armenian: պալէնա (palēna)

Etymology 2

[edit]

Verb

[edit]

balena

  1. inflection of balenare:
    1. third-person singular present indicative
    2. second-person singular imperative

Further reading

[edit]
  • balena in Treccani.it – Vocabolario Treccani on line, Istituto dell'Enciclopedia Italiana

Anagrams

[edit]
  • banale
